properties.text: Here the base-image gets prepared to be added to the Dataset. Change settings or crop manually if necessary.

widgets_values:
# Character Dataset (GPT-Image-2)

Generates a **25-image LoRA training dataset** of one character from a single photo,
via `openai/gpt-image-2` on Replicate. **No GPU is used** - local nodes only crop and
resize; every generation is an API call.

## Setup
1. **Token** - `custom_nodes/comfyui-arkennemesis/.env` needs `REPLICATE_API_TOKEN=r8_...`
2. **Load your photo** into the `Load Image` node (INPUTS). Full-body, well-lit,
   front-facing works best - the face crop is derived from it.
3. **Set NAME** (INPUTS) - it drives every output path.
4. Optionally fill **STYLE** and **CLOTHES**; they are appended to all 24 prompts.

## Cost - read before Run
A full run is **24 sequential API calls at quality=high**, roughly **45-65 min**.
Test one shot first: mute (Ctrl+M) the groups you are not testing. `force_rerun` is
off, so re-queueing an unchanged shot does not re-bill - only what you changed.

## Prompts
Each shot is three lines - `Framing:` / `Scene:` / `Lighting:` - joined with the shared
IDENTITY and EXCLUDE blocks (see the PROMPT TEMPLATE group).
**Framing must stay first**, and never write "full body" unconditionally in the shared
block: both mistakes make close-up shots come back as full-body.
Do not convert these to JSON - OpenAI recommends a skimmable labeled template.

## Aspect ratio / quality
`aspect_ratio` is a COMBO, and ComfyUI rejects STRING->COMBO links, so it cannot be
wired to one shared node. Patch all 24 at once:
`python claude/workflow-runbooks/character-dataset-gptimage2/set_shot_options.py --aspect 1:1`
then reload this workflow.

nodes.title: WARDROBE NOTES [OPTIONAL] - things worn in EVERY shot
IDENTITY BLOCK (all 24 shots)
widgets_values:
Subject: the SAME person shown in the reference images.

Reference roles:
Image 1: face and hair identity anchor - use it for the exact likeness.
Image 2: a wider view of the same person - use it for skin tone, build and hair length.
Do NOT copy the clothing from the references: each shot states its own Wardrobe below.

Use the references ONLY for the person's identity and appearance. Do NOT copy their crop,
camera distance, pose or background - the Framing, Scene and Lighting lines above define
this shot and always override the references.

Preserve exactly: face geometry, facial features, eye colour, eyebrows, hairline, hair
texture and colour, skin tone, distinguishing marks, and - wherever the body is visible -
the same body proportions. Do not change the face, skin tone or identity in any way. It
must be unmistakably the same person.

nodes.title: EXCLUDE BLOCK (all 24 shots)
widgets_values:
Exclude: text, captions, watermarks, logos, borders, collage or split frames,
additional people, duplicated or malformed hands and limbs, plastic or over-smoothed skin,
heavy beauty retouching.
Output: a single photorealistic photograph.
